mapper.select: select id, user_id, username, password_hash, status, token_version, create_time, update_time from mall_user where username = #{username} limit 1
select id, user_id, username, password_hash, status, token_version, create_time, update_time from mall_user where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into mall_user(user_id, username, password_hash, status, token_version, create_time, update_time) values(#{userId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{tokenVersion}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update mall_user set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, token_version = token_version + 1, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and token_version = #{expectedTokenVersion} and status = 1
